title: Yoggi – Safe AI Chatbot for Kids
excerpt: Age-adapted AI for children 3–15. Voice chat, parental controls, 12 languages. Free on iOS & Android.
content_html:
AI for kids · Ages 3–15

The AI Built for Kids. Safe, Smart, and Age-Aware.

Yoggi adapts to your child's age — simple answers for toddlers, richer conversations for teenagers. Voice chat, strict content filtering, and full parental control built in.

Ages 3–15

12 Languages

Voice-Enabled

Live Voice Calls

AI Image Generation

Parental Controls

Real-Time Safety Alerts

iOS & Android

COPPA & GDPR Compliant

🛡️

Safe by Design

Violence, sexuality, and inappropriate topics are refused by the AI itself — not filtered after the fact. Yoggi redirects gently, with humor, never with a cold error message.

🎯

Adapts to Their Age

A 4-year-old and a 13-year-old get completely different answers to the same question. Vocabulary, sentence length, and complexity adjust automatically to the child's profile.

🎙️

Voice-First for Young Kids

Children who can't yet read or type can simply speak. Yoggi listens, responds, and reads answers aloud — making it accessible from age 3.

👨‍👩‍👧

Parents Stay in Control

A PIN-protected Parents' Corner gives you access to the full chat history. Know exactly what your child has been asking and learning, at any time.

🌍

12 Languages

French, Spanish, German, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, and more. Yoggi always responds in your child's language, making it useful for families worldwide.

✅

Honest About Being an AI

Yoggi never pretends to be human. When asked, it explains its AI nature in age-appropriate terms — building healthy digital literacy from an early age.

🔔

Real-Time Safety Alerts

If a conversation ever raises a genuine concern, Yoggi emails you right away — with a calm, factual explanation, not an alarming notification. You're never the last to know.

📊

Daily & Weekly Insights

A daily AI-generated snapshot of mood and topics, plus an optional weekly email recap — free on every plan, so you stay informed without reading every message.

📞

Real-Time Voice Call

One tap opens a live, two-way voice conversation with Yoggi — no text on screen. Reviewed for safety afterward, with the full transcript available to parents only.

🎨

AI Image Generation

Ask Yoggi to draw something, and a cute, cartoon-style image appears right in the chat — guarded by three layers of safety, from the prompt to the pixels.

📚

Free Play or Learning Mode

Choose how Yoggi leans: open, playful conversation, or always steered back toward discovery and learning. Parent-controlled, changeable anytime.

Yoggi Has Moods

A friend who reacts, not just a chatbot that replies.

Alongside every reply, Yoggi picks a mood — content, excited, surprised, playful, tender — so conversations feel alive, not robotic.

3–5

Little Explorers

3-sentence maximum answers. Only the simplest vocabulary. Voice-first — no reading or typing required. Endlessly patient.

6–10

Curious Minds

Homework help, fun facts, creative stories. Clear explanations that spark curiosity without being overwhelming.

11–15

Growing Thinkers

Deeper conversations, study assistance, a space to explore ideas. More nuanced answers, always age-appropriate.

For Parents

Complete visibility.
Zero worry.

Every conversation your child has with Yoggi is available to you. Not because we track them — because you should always know.

  • ✓ PIN-protected Parents' Corner — children can't access it
  • ✓ Full chat history, always readable
  • ✓ Real-time email alert if a conversation ever needs your attention
  • ✓ Daily AI insights & optional weekly recap by email
  • ✓ Flag sensitive family topics (grief, separation, illness) for extra care
  • ✓ No violence, drugs, or sexual content — ever. Redirected with humor, not rejection
  • ✓ COPPA & GDPR compliant

Is Yoggi safe for young children?

Yes. Yoggi is purpose-built for children aged 3–15. It refuses to discuss violence, sexuality, drugs, or any age-inappropriate content. When a child tries to steer the conversation somewhere inappropriate, Yoggi redirects with humor — not a cold error message. Parents can review the full chat history at any time through the PIN-protected Parents' Corner.

What age is Yoggi designed for?

Yoggi is designed for children aged 3 to 15. The AI automatically adjusts its vocabulary, response length, and complexity based on the child's age: simple 3-sentence answers for children under 7, more detailed explanations for older kids and teenagers.

How is Yoggi different from ChatGPT or Gemini?

ChatGPT and Gemini are designed for adults. They have no age-awareness, no automatic content filtering, and no parental controls. Yoggi is purpose-built for children: it adapts to the child's specific age, refuses inappropriate content by design, supports voice input and text-to-speech for young readers, and gives parents full visibility through a protected dashboard.

How do parental controls work?

Parents access a PIN-protected "Parents' Corner" where they can browse the full chat history, manage child profiles, and adjust settings. The PIN ensures children cannot access or modify parental settings.

Does Yoggi work in languages other than English?

Yes. Yoggi supports 12 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Russian, and Indonesian. The AI always responds in the language configured for the child's profile.

Can my child use Yoggi for homework help?

Yes. Yoggi can help with homework questions, explain concepts, and encourage curiosity — always at the right level for your child's age. It explains things in age-appropriate language rather than giving ready-made answers, which supports actual learning.

Is Yoggi free?

Yoggi is free to download: every child gets 50 AI messages for life plus a daily allowance (10–100 messages/day, set by the parent). A premium subscription removes the 50-message lifetime cap; the daily allowance still applies.

Can a 3-year-old use an AI chatbot?

With Yoggi, yes. For children aged 3–5, Yoggi uses the simplest possible vocabulary, responds in very short sentences, and supports voice input — so children who can't yet read or type can have a conversation by speaking.

Is Yoggi COPPA and GDPR compliant?

Yes. Yoggi complies with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) and GDPR-K requirements. The app is available on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, both of which enforce strict child privacy standards.

Does Yoggi tell children it is an AI?

Yes, always. Yoggi never pretends to be human. When a child asks what Yoggi is, the app explains it is an AI in age-appropriate terms — simply for young children, more accurately for teenagers.

Does Yoggi alert me if something is wrong?

Yes. Every message your child sends is analyzed as it happens. If a conversation raises a genuine concern, Yoggi emails you immediately with a calm, factual explanation of what happened — capped at one alert email per day so you're informed without being overwhelmed. The alert always reminds you that it's AI-generated and doesn't replace your own judgment or professional advice.

What are the Daily AI Insights and Weekly Recap?

Every night, Yoggi analyzes your child's previous day of conversation and generates a short insight: mood, topics discussed, engagement level, and anything worth your attention. It's viewable in the app and included free on every plan. If you turn it on, a weekly recap combining the week's daily insights is also emailed to you.

Can I tell Yoggi about a sensitive situation in our family?

Yes. From the settings, you can flag sensitive topics — grief, separation, illness, and others — so Yoggi pays extra attention if your child brings them up. This never lowers Yoggi's baseline safety rules; it only makes Yoggi more attentive and gentle around topics that matter to your family right now.

Can my child have a live voice call with Yoggi?

Yes. Yoggi has a real-time voice call mode: your child taps a phone button and talks to Yoggi live, with continuous two-way audio and no text on screen. The full transcript is available to you afterward in the history; your child cannot reopen it. Free accounts get 5 minutes for life, premium accounts get 10 minutes a day.

Can Yoggi generate images for my child?

Yes. When a child asks to see something, Yoggi can generate a cartoon-style image right inside the chat. Every request passes through three layers of safety, including a fixed style template that forbids scary content, text, realistic people, or copyrighted characters. Free accounts get 5 images for life, premium accounts get 15 per day.

Can I make Yoggi more focused on learning instead of free chat?

Yes. You can choose between Free Play, where Yoggi chats about anything your child brings up, and Learning Mode, where it always steers conversations back toward reflection and discovery. It's set during onboarding and changeable anytime from settings; your child never sees or controls it, and safety rules stay identical in both modes.

Give your child a smarter companion.

Free to download. Works in 12 languages. Safe for ages 3–15.

content_html_zh:
面向儿童的人工智能 · 3-15 岁

专为儿童打造的人工智能。 安全、智能且具有年龄意识。

Yoggi 会适应您孩子的年龄——为幼儿提供简单的答案，为青少年提供更丰富的对话。 内置语音聊天、严格的内容过滤和全面的家长控制。

Ages 3–15

12 种语言

语音功能

实时语音通话

人工智能图像生成

家长控制

实时安全警报

iOS & 安卓

符合 COPPA 和 GDPR

🛡️

安全设计

暴力、性和不恰当的话题都会被人工智能本身拒绝——而不是事后过滤。 Yoggi 会温和、幽默地进行重定向，而不是冷冰冰的错误消息。

🎯

适应他们的年龄

对于同一个问题，一个 4 岁的孩子和一个 13 岁的孩子得到了完全不同的答案。 词汇量、句子长度和复杂性会根据孩子的个人资料自动调整。

🎙️

幼儿语音优先

还不会阅读或打字的孩子可以简单地说话。 Yoggi 会大声倾听、回应并读出答案——让 3 岁的孩子能够轻松掌握。

👨‍👩‍👧

家长掌控一切

受 PIN 码保护的家长角让您可以访问完整的聊天历史记录。 随时准确了解您的孩子一直在问什么和学什么。

🌍

12 种语言

法语、西班牙语、德语、日语、中文、印地语等。 Yoggi 始终以您孩子的语言进行回应，这对世界各地的家庭都有用。

✅

诚实地对待人工智能

约吉从不假装自己是人类。 当被问到时，它用适合年龄的术语解释了人工智能的本质——从小培养健康的数字素养。

🔔

实时安全警报

如果谈话中引起了真正的担忧，Yoggi 会立即向您发送电子邮件，并提供冷静、事实的解释，而不是令人震惊的通知。 你永远不是最后一个知道的。

📊

每日和每周见解

人工智能每日生成的情绪和主题快照，以及可选的每周电子邮件回顾 - 每个计划都是免费的，因此您无需阅读每条消息即可随时了解情况。

📞

实时语音通话

只需轻按一下，即可与 Yoggi 进行实时双向语音对话 - 屏幕上没有文字。 随后进行了安全审查，完整的成绩单仅供家长使用。

🎨

人工智能图像生成

让 Yoggi 画一些东西，聊天中就会出现一个可爱的卡通风格的图像 - 由从提示到像素的三层安全保护。

📚

免费游戏或学习模式

选择 Yoggi 的倾向：开放、有趣的对话，或始终转向发现和学习。 家长控制，随时更改。

瑜伽士有情绪

一个会做出反应的朋友，而不仅仅是一个会回复的聊天机器人。

除了每次回复外，Yoggi 还会选择一种情绪——满足、兴奋、惊讶、俏皮、温柔——让对话感觉充满活力，而不是机械的。

3–5

小小探险家

最多 3 句话答案。 只有最简单的词汇。 语音优先——无需阅读或打字。 无尽的耐心。

6–10

好奇心

家庭作业帮助、有趣的事实、创意故事。 清晰的解释既能激发好奇心，又不会让人不知所措。

11–15

成长的思想家

更深入的对话、学习帮助、探索想法的空间。 更细致的答案，始终适合年龄。

致家长

完全可见。零担心。

您可以查看您孩子与 Yoggi 的每一次对话。 不是因为我们追踪它们——因为你应该永远知道。

  • ✓ 受 PIN 码保护的家长角 — 儿童无法访问
  • ✓ 完整的聊天记录，始终可读
  • ✓ 如果对话需要您注意，实时电子邮件提醒
  • ✓ 每日人工智能见解和可选的每周通过电子邮件进行回顾
  • ✓ 标记敏感的家庭话题（悲伤、分离、疾病）以供额外关注
  • ✓ 永远不包含暴力、毒品或色情内容。 以幽默的方式重定向，而不是拒绝
  • ✓ 符合 COPPA 和 GDPR 标准

Is Yoggi safe for young children?

是的。 Yoggi 专为 3 至 15 岁的儿童打造。 它拒绝讨论暴力、性、毒品或任何不适合年龄的内容。 当孩子试图将谈话引向不合适的地方时，约吉会用幽默来引导——而不是冷酷的错误信息。 家长可以通过受 PIN 码保护的家长角随时查看完整的聊天记录。

What age is Yoggi designed for?

Yoggi 专为 3 至 15 岁的儿童设计。 人工智能会根据孩子的年龄自动调整其词汇量、回答长度和复​​杂性：为 7 岁以下的孩子提供简单的 3 句话答案，为年龄较大的孩子和青少年提供更详细的解释。

How is Yoggi different from ChatGPT or Gemini?

ChatGPT 和 Gemini 是为成人设计的。 他们没有年龄意识，没有自动内容过滤，也没有家长控制。 Yoggi 专为儿童打造：它适应孩子的特定年龄，通过设计拒绝不适当的内容，支持年轻读者的语音输入和文本转语音，并通过受保护的仪表板为家长提供全面的可见性。

How do parental controls work?

家长可以访问受 PIN 码保护的“家长角”，在这里他们可以浏览完整的聊天历史记录、管理孩子的个人资料并调整设置。 PIN 可确保儿童无法访问或修改家长设置。

Does Yoggi work in languages other than English?

是的。 Yoggi 支持 12 种语言：英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、日语、韩语、中文、印地语、俄语和印度尼西亚语。 AI 始终以为孩子的个人资料配置的语言进行响应。

Can my child use Yoggi for homework help?

是的。 Yoggi 可以帮助解决家庭作业问题、解释概念并鼓励好奇心——始终处于适合您孩子年龄的水平。 它用适合年龄的语言解释事物，而不是给出现成的答案，这支持实际学习。

Is Yoggi free?

Yoggi 可免费下载：每个孩子一生都会收到 50 条 AI 消息，外加每日津贴（每天 10-100 条消息，由家长设置）。 高级订阅取消了 50 条消息的生命周期上限；每日津贴仍然适用。

Can a 3-year-old use an AI chatbot?

对于约吉来说，是的。 对于 3 至 5 岁的儿童，Yoggi 使用最简单的词汇，用非常短的句子进行回应，并支持语音输入 - 因此还不会阅读或打字的孩子可以通过说话进行对话。

Is Yoggi COPPA and GDPR compliant?

是的。 Yoggi 遵守 COPPA（儿童在线隐私保护法）和 GDPR-K 要求。 该应用程序可在 Apple App Store 和 Google Play Store 上使用，这两个商店都执行严格的儿童隐私标准。

Does Yoggi tell children it is an AI?

是的，总是如此。 约吉从不假装自己是人类。 当孩子问 Yoggi 是什么时，该应用程序以适合年龄的术语解释说它是一种人工智能——仅适用于幼儿，更准确地说适用于青少年。

Does Yoggi alert me if something is wrong?

是的。 您孩子发送的每条消息都会在发生时进行分析。 如果谈话引起了真正的担忧，Yoggi 会立即向您发送电子邮件，对所发生的事情进行冷静、真实的解释 - 每天最多发送一封提醒电子邮件，以便您收到通知而不会不知所措。 该警报始终提醒您，它是人工智能生成的，不会取代您自己的判断或专业建议。

What are the Daily AI Insights and Weekly Recap?

每天晚上，Yoggi 都会分析您孩子前一天的谈话并生成简短的见解：情绪、讨论的主题、参与程度以及任何值得您关注的内容。 它可以在应用程序中查看，并且每个计划都免费提供。 如果您打开它，还会通过电子邮件向您发送结合本周每日见解的每周回顾。

Can I tell Yoggi about a sensitive situation in our family?

是的。 在设置中，您可以标记敏感话题——悲伤、分离、疾病等——这样，如果您的孩子提起这些话题，Yoggi 就会格外注意。 这永远不会降低 Yoggi 的安全基线规则；它只会让 Yoggi 在当前对你的家人重要的话题上更加专注和温柔。

Can my child have a live voice call with Yoggi?

是的。 Yoggi 具有实时语音通话模式：您的孩子点击电话按钮即可与 Yoggi 进行实时通话，并有连续的双向音频，屏幕上没有文字。 您可以在历史记录中查看完整的成绩单；您的孩子无法重新打开它。 免费帐户终身可使用 5 分钟，高级帐户每天可使用 10 分钟。

Can Yoggi generate images for my child?

是的。 当孩子要求看某些东西时，Yoggi 可以在聊天中生成卡通风格的图像。 每个请求都会经过三层安全保护，包括固定样式模板，禁止恐怖内容、文本、现实人物或受版权保护的角色。 免费帐户终身可获得 5 张图片，高级帐户每天可获得 15 张图片。

Can I make Yoggi more focused on learning instead of free chat?

是的。 您可以在“自由游戏”和“学习模式”之间进行选择，在“自由游戏”中，Yoggi 可以谈论您孩子提出的任何问题，而在“学习模式”中，它始终将对话引向反思和发现。 它是在入职期间设置的，并且可以随时通过设置进行更改；您的孩子永远不会看到或控制它，并且两种模式下的安全规则保持相同。
